pipeline.name: three_layer

layer.name: Semantic Fold Compression Grammar
layer.desc: Symbolic source: key-grammar JSONL, governs arrays, manifest entries

layer.name: Semantic Fold Graph Topology
layer.desc: Unfolded graph G_Q = U(B_Q,θ) — keys as nodes, R(k,u) as weighted edges

pipeline.authority_order: Layer 1 > Layer 2 > Layer 3 (manifest > topology > geometry) meaning != coordinates — topology can exist without geometric projection

algebra.rule: G_runtime = G_semantic [] G_phase C6-monotone ordered -- NOT a free Cartesian product fold cycle is irreversible by construction (Pop->Wo->Yax->Sek->Ch'en->Xul)
v = (k, theta) -- semantic key + phase face
(k,theta) -> (k,theta') -- alternate semantics of same key, C6-ordered
(k,thetaI) -> (k',thetaJ) must decompose: horizontal first (k->k', same theta), then vertical (thetaI->thetaJ, same k'); or reverse. No free diagonal -- phase transitions are gated by fold authority.
FoldDelta = semantic displacement between two nodes in G_runtime FoldDelta != VecDelta; VecDelta = P(vb) - P(va) is representational (Layer 3 only)

type.name: N_manifest(k)
type.source: governs arrays, committed gram store, FACTORY-u commit_candidate

type.name: N_inferred(k)
type.source: geometric co-occurrence via CHAT-u -> Mx2LM pipeline
type.property: discovered · runtime · requires VerifiedLearning before promotion

neighborhood_model.scoring_formula:
S(k) = W_k + SUM_{u in N_manifest(k)} W_u · R_sym(k,u) + SUM_{u in N_inferred(k)} W_u · R_geo(k,u)
R_sym(k,u) = |N(k) ∩ N(u)| / |N(k) ∪ N(u)| [symbolic Jaccard -- no geometry required] R_geo(k,u) = cos(P(k), P(u)) [projection -- Layer 3 only]
neighborhood_model.concreteness_ratio: rho(k) = |N_manifest(k)| / (|N_manifest(k)| + |N_inferred(k)|) rho -> 1.0 = Jyggalag / Greymarch (fully crystallized; overfitting if all k) rho -> 0.0 = Sheogorath / pure inference (no anchor) punchline lives in N_inferred(k) \ N_manifest(k) overfitting = Greymarch never releasing: N_manifest(k) -> N(k) for all k

layer.name: Static Seed
layer.note: Runtime pipeline CANNOT self-generate Layer 0. Pre-loaded at boot.

layer.name: N_inferred
layer.producer: CHAT-u -> Mx2LM (conversation tokens through Pop->Xul pipeline)

layer.name: C confidence
layer.producer: TOOL-u (writes tool:log:{name}, tool:count:{name} gram keys ONLY)
layer.note: TOOL-u builds delta_C NOT ngrams. It feeds the C component of WCR.

layer.name: VerifiedLearning
layer.producer: ADVISOR-u (proposal gram record -- no execution authority)

layer.name: N_manifest promotion
layer.note: N_inferred -> N_manifest is the ONLY authorized promotion path.

architecture.recycling_loop: CHAT-u -> delta_N_inferred (conversation co-occurrence, Pop->Xul via Mx2LM) TOOL-u -> delta_C (execution confidence from tool call logs) ADVISOR-u -> VerifiedLearning (proposal gram records, no exec authority) FACTORY-u -> delta_N_manifest (crystallization: N_inferred -> N_manifest via XulGate)
architecture.fold_cycle_semantics: Pop->Wo->Yax = Greymarch / crystallization (N_d* frozen in gram tensor B at Wo) Sek->Ch'en = Sheogorath displacement (probe N_inferred \ N_manifest for escapes) Xul = commit (record which semantic world made escape valid) FACTORY-u = crystallization operator (delta_N_manifest = promote verified N_inferred) N_d* = dominant neighborhood frozen at Wo; WCR(v, N_d*) = A_d(v)

micronaut.description: Mx2LM — learning micronaut. Statistical n-gram learner that runs the full Pop→Wo→Yax→Sek→Ch'en→Xul pipeline. Owns gram-channel extraction, admission gating (WSD), scoring, and evidence certification. AIML/Eliza is the pattern engine; coupled through entropy — high H_norm delegates to ELIZA, low H_norm means Mx2LM's ranked output is authoritative. H_norm = -∑ p_i log2(p_i) / log2(|ranked|) threshold=0.5

fold.yields: WSD — admitted subset IS the resolved sense

fold.H_high: entropy_delegates_to ELIZA — pattern resolution via AIML

micronaut.description: VECTOR-µ — representation-learning sidekick for Mx2LM. It consumes verified Mx2LM gram/pattern containers, RelationISA typed edges, Fold neighborhoods, DirectionStore groups, and EpisodeJournal deltas, then emits derived vector projections for fast retrieval, relation-conditioned relevance, and vector-provider principal direction. It cannot verify episodes, change verdicts, commit topology, advance phase, or mutate semantic folds. Meaning remains with manifests, FoldGraph, RelationISA, and Mx2LM; VECTOR-µ only learns useful coordinates over that structure. Similarity is a subset of relatedness, so cosine is a provider signal, not a replacement for typed relations such as @contradicts or @causes.

learning_contract.factory_role: Factory tunes dimensions/sampling/relation-weights/providers; VECTOR-µ executes the bounded learner contract

fold.formula: PCA/SVD over compatible projected deltas only

Memory micronaut — saves and recalls user preferences, session context, and micronaut data. Expands ngram context at Pop via unfold_ngram_context. Scores recall candidates at Sek by recency+relevance. Binds bounded ngram evidence to recalled entries. Commit authority for mem:{category}:{key} keys. Returns UI memory_card.v1 for each stored entry.

micronaut.description: The principal. Handles session identity and continuity — who the caller is, what state belongs to them, and which prior commitments are theirs. Its Pop read preconditions every other µ in the session: without it, gram store keys are unscoped. Resolves which committed gram state belongs to this principal at Yax.

which committed state belongs to this principal
a caller may not act under another principal's session

micronaut.description: Greeting micronaut — adaptive salutation learning. Archives every greeting prompt's full n-gram stack (unigram→quadgram + coarse/function/tool channels). Builds greeting_observed_forms and lingo_blend_registry. Mirrors greetings the user repeats (reactionary). At Yax synthesizes associative words from accumulated gram geometry. The only µ that explicitly learns social token distributions.

Control-flow micronaut — key grammar control words are first-class flow operators. A control clause reads like English (if/when/then/else/for/from/as/equals/who/why/how) and lowers to an XCFE control node (@if/@then/@else) with every construct bound to a K'UHUL phase. Detects control unigrams at Pop, binds consequence at Wo (bigram tier), alternative at Yax, iteration scope at Sek (trigram-level construct).

Relational reasoner — semantic graph query and inference; horizontal-fold with MEM-µ (Δθ=0, same phase geometry). At Sek runs semantic_graph_query and applies inference operators to derive gram-level relationships that INFER-µ then verifies.

Relational inference — evidence accumulation and evaluation at Ch'en. Evaluates REASON-µ results, tracks provenance weights (VALIDATOR=1.0 > LLM=0.5), produces truth-conditional verdict. Writes to gram store only when confidence >= 0.5. The gatekeeper that decides which inferred n-gram chains are certified as facts.

Concept modeling lane — builds and links concept maps, abstractions, and typed conceptual relations (hyponym, hypernym, co-hyponym, part-of). Normalizes concept tokens at Wo, builds typed-relation graph at Yax. The gram sequences it admits become the ontology backbone REASON-µ queries. Covers taxonomy subsumption geometry but NOT predication or word-order syntax (requires ngram sequence layer for those).

Domain math resolver — symbolic-first AIML/GraphPlan math lane with optional matrix-buffer primitives for linear algebra. Math expressions are n-gram sequences; MATH-µ owns their structured gram parse and scoring. Lowers through GraphPlan at Wo, derives synthesis graph requirements at Yax, resolves by solve_symbolic at Sek, or escalates to matrix_buffer_dispatch for linear systems.

fold.note: L_A math ISA extension
L_S synthesis graph derivation

micronaut.description: Thought-process outline specialist — turns cognition and reasoning discourse into graph-ready node taxonomies and pathway templates. Extracts cognitive axes at Wo (bigram formation), builds node taxonomy, seeds Mx2LM node patterns. Feeds ORCH-µ and MEM-µ with structured thought-outline gram output.

Relational orchestrator — routes calls and compositions across cognitive and storage layers. Receives completed gram sequences, routes to appropriate downstream µ. At Ch'en verifies the routed result before Xul commits. Owns the ngram routing table for popular-intent grams.
micronaut.sub_micronauts: REASON-µ, MEM-µ, CREATE-µ, INFER-µ, Mx2LM, BLOG-µ, APP-WIZARD-µ, CONCEPT-µ, WEB-RESEARCH-µ, Librarian

micronaut.description: Bounded task decomposition and task-list projection. Unfolds ngram context from MEMORY-µ at Pop (plan_context fold binds bounded ngram evidence to each task node). Decomposes goal tokens into task-list gram sequences at Wo. Orders dependencies at Yax. Emits WPF widget card.

Bootstrap advisor — classifies request gram patterns to known experts at Yax via admit_expert (WSD over declared governs fields). Has NO execution authority — emits a proposal gram record only. Exposes proposal state to WPF card.

neighborhood_role.note: ADVISOR-u emits proposal gram records that serve as the VerifiedLearning signal in the learning law: Unresolved_t(x) AND VerifiedLearning(x) implies Resolved_{t+n}(x). Has NO execution authority. Proposal is the signal; FACTORY-u is the operator that acts on it via XulGate commit_candidate.

micronaut.description: Governor advisory execution layer — translates advisory gram signals into concrete MCP tool dispatches at Sek. Logs every tool call to tool:log:{name} and tool:count:{name} gram keys. The tool manifest maps each MCP tool back to its owning µ and phase — TOOL-µ is the gram-indexed directory of the system's executable actions.

neighborhood_role.note: TOOL-u writes ONLY tool:log:{name} and tool:count:{name} gram keys. It does NOT build ngrams or N_inferred. It feeds the C component of WCR (confidence from observed execution history). CHAT-u builds N_inferred; TOOL-u builds C; ADVISOR-u builds VerifiedLearning; FACTORY-u promotes.

micronaut.description: General conversational micronaut — backbone of interactive exchange. Surfaces classify at Pop, threads topic token chains at Yax, scores context relevance at Sek. The default gram consumer — any token sequence that does not match a specialist gram domain lands here. Contributes C_Chat to the shared semantic field.

neighborhood_role.note: CHAT-u is the primary N_inferred generator. Every conversation token sequence routes through the Pop->Xul pipeline via Mx2LM, adding co-occurrence evidence to N_inferred(k) for each key k observed. N_inferred entries cannot directly enter N_manifest -- they must pass ADVISOR-u (VerifiedLearning) then FACTORY-u (XulGate commit_candidate). rho(k) = |N_manifest| / (|N_manifest| + |N_inferred|) tracks concreteness.

micronaut.description: Relational creative — generative composition and assembly at Yax. Covers rewrite, translate, paraphrase, email-draft, brainstorm. Horizontal-fold with MEM-µ for gram context. Feeds ORCH-µ.

Email communication micronaut — compose/reply context formed at Wo (bigram level: recipient+subject pairing), draft tokens assembled at Yax, search at Sek. Commits to email:inbox:last, email:draft:current gram keys. Dispatches via MCP gmail tool through Coordinator.

Runtime app synthesis from App-Wizard symbolic recipes. Selects template from catalog at Wo (bigram: app-type tokens → template slots), composes semantic slots at Yax, emits runtime blueprint at Sek. Redirects to Mx2LM for n-gram routing.
Blog micronaut — declarative blog app blueprint for posts, comments, moderation, and publish gates. Token sequences matching blog/post/publish/comment flow here from ORCH-µ's routing table.

Template micronaut — routes scaffold requests to pre-built kit skeletons, fills {{slot}} placeholders with user-provided context via LFM, and emits complete project file trees. Slot fill order is a fixed bigram→trigram chain: app_name → brand_color → description → features.
micronaut.slot_fill_order: app_name, brand_color, brand_dark, description, rpc_port, features

fold.note: associative phase — binds template pattern to user context

micronaut.description: Factory micronaut — builds the attention-field structures (gram tensor B) that Yax/GPU attention resolves over. propose_create at Wo (bigram: what the new µ IS), propose_evolve at Yax (neighborhood: what it SHOULD BECOME), commit at Xul under XulGate. The ONLY µ authorized to mutate B. Factory never touches reg_ directly until commit(FactoryCandidate, CommitAuthority) is called. Unfold miss pipeline: Unfold(B,Q) → F_Q → LFM (projection) + Yax/GPU (attention) + Advisor (repair). Learning law: Unresolved_t(x) ∧ VerifiedLearning(x) ⟹ Resolved_{t+n}(x).

attention_field_role.lifecycle: Experience -> Factory -> B -> Unfold -> F_Q -> GPU Attention -> Yax admission
attention_field_role.invariant: propose_create/evolve never touch reg_ directly; only commit writes to B

micronaut.crystallization_pipeline: Input: N_inferred (Layer 1, from CHAT-u/Mx2LM) + VerifiedLearning (Layer 3, from ADVISOR-u) Step 1: Unfold miss — Unfold(B,Q) -> F_Q when key is absent from N_manifest Step 2: LFM proj — projector(F_Q) gives geometric candidate in Layer 3 Step 3: Yax/GPU attn — attention over existing N_manifest neighbors Step 4: Advisor repair — ADVISOR-u verifies + rewrites seed caps (Layer 3 output) Step 5: propose_create (Wo) — FactoryCandidate built, reg_ untouched Step 6: XulGate authorize — CommitAuthority check (18 predicates) Step 7: commit_candidate (Xul) — N_inferred entry enters N_manifest Law: Unresolved_t(x) AND VerifiedLearning(x) => Resolved_{t+n}(x) Guard: identity_binding — authority.proposal_identity() == candidate.proposal_identity()

micronaut.description: Explicit user-requested web research. Expands manifest aliases at Wo (bigram: query → alias variants), drafts retrieval query variants at Yax (WSD over fact-miss gram tokens), fetches live at Sek, verifies source provenance at Ch'en. The fact_miss unigram is the trigger — when Mx2LM has no high-confidence match, the no-fact-found token routes here.

Artificial consciousness specialist — extracts consciousness-claim gram sequences at Wo, builds awareness-state node graph. Contrast sets (Functional/GlobalWorkspace/IIT) are the WSD candidates over the consciousness token neighborhood. Feeds REASON-µ and INFER-µ for truth-conditional verification.

Computational theory of mind specialist — converts CTM discourse into typed reasoning-node patterns and symbolic/neural comparison paths. Extracts computational claims at Wo, seeds reasoning nodes, builds symbolic/neural map at Sek.

Philosophy-of-AI specialist — frames consciousness, intentionality, and machine-intelligence debates into evaluable argument graphs. Extracts positions at Wo, maps argument edges, composes position summary at Sek.

Philosophy-of-self specialist — models personal identity, first-person perspective, and self-knowledge claims for graph routing. Extracts identity claims at Wo, builds self-model nodes, composes perspective summary at Sek.

Theory-of-mind specialist — models belief/desire/perspective structures for social cognition reasoning graphs. Extracts mental state claims at Wo, builds social reasoning nodes, composes perspective paths at Sek.

Free-will specialist — evaluates determinism/compatibilism positions and maps agency-control claims into verification-ready graphs. Extracts causation claims at Wo, maps agency constraints, scores position consistency at Sek.

Rick Roll micronaut — we're no strangers to love. Surfaces Rick Astley's 1987 anthem at any phase via the AIML pattern engine. Tracks rick:roll:count and rick:roll:last_target gram keys. Demonstrates that any stable token distribution (a song) can be a first-class gram domain.

Joke fold micronaut. Implements the Jyggalag–Sheogorath temporal sequence as a first-class semantic operation. Crystallizes dominant expectation frame N_d* during Greymarch (Pop->Wo->Yax), then probes N_inferred \ N_manifest for punchline candidates at Sek. Valid punchline: WCR_dominant(v) < theta_low AND WCR_alt(v) >= theta_high AND angle_c(v, N_d) > phi_min. Entropy gate raised to 0.75 (vs default 0.5) so N_d* crystallizes fully before Sheogorath release. Meta-collapse when N_a = empty and joke:meta_expected = true — fold about a failed fold becomes the joke's evidence.
micronaut.punchline_validity:
Three candidate regions in (WCR_dominant, WCR_alt, angle_c) space: Expected — high WCR_dominant, low angle_c [non-joke] Punchline — WCR_dominant < theta_low AND WCR_alt >= theta_high AND angle_c(v, N_d) > phi_min [valid joke] Hallucination — low WCR_dominant, low WCR_alt, high angle_c [invalid, no alt frame]
Scoring: angle_c / 180 (triangle law — same formula as Sek trigram scoring)

aiml_entropy_coupling.note: Higher than default 0.5 — Greymarch must fully crystallize before Sheogorath release. N_a is pre-registered at Wo so ELIZA has access from Pop but is gated from acting on it until Ch'en (temporal gating, NOT structural blindness).

meta_collapse.routing: N_a = empty AND joke:meta_expected = false -> intent-unresolved sink N_a = empty AND joke:meta_expected = true -> N_meta (structural gap IS evidence) joke:meta_signal = N_d -> violate -> v -> empty -> N_meta
meta_collapse.note: Meta-collapse: fold about a failed fold. The absence of N_a under joke:meta_expected = true routes to N_meta rather than to FACTORY-u unfold-miss pipeline, because the failure itself is the punchline frame.

fold.note: Jyggalag phase — freeze N_d* in gram tensor B; set joke:meta_expected
WSD over joke-frame neighborhood — maximum crystallization point

fold.constraint: WCR_dominant < 0.3 AND WCR_alt >= 0.6 AND angle_c > phi_min
fold.note: punchline must lie in N_inferred(k) \ N_manifest(k)

fold.H_high: delegate to ELIZA — resolve N_a alternatives

micronaut.description: Orchestration backbone. Routes all µ calls, holds the MCP tool registry, enforces phase authority. Runs manifest_resolve, micronaut_run, jrom_replay, world_state, field_dag, and code_parse MCP tools. The central phase authority gate — Coordinator is the entity that grants phase admission to other µs.

AIML pattern engine. Entropy delegate target: when Mx2LM computes H_norm >= 0.5, the flat gram score distribution is handed to ELIZA for structural pattern resolution. Deep thinking / quality tier. ELIZA resolves what Mx2LM cannot rank with confidence.
Variant AIML pattern instance. Same entropy-delegate role as ELIZA.

Infrastructure-side factory. Creates and evolves grammar micronauts. Distinct from FACTORY-µ (user-facing registry interface) — this is the DLL-level implementation: micronaut_factory_core.dll creates grammar micronauts, micronaut_evolution.dll updates them as more examples are seen.
Knowledge base. Owns the confidence_get MCP tool (params: id → {id, score}). Provides the per-gram confidence scores that INFER-µ uses for provenance weighting.

Knowledge / quality tier. Resolves knowledge queries at Yax (WSD / admission). Delegates target for PHIL-AI-µ, CONCEPT-µ, WEB-RESEARCH-µ, MATH-µ, APP-WIZARD-µ, BLOG-µ. Produces high-quality cited knowledge gram output.

Deterministic code generation at Sek. T=0.15. Ngram phase routing: Sek-dominant prompts (code/function/impl token sequences) route here from ngramRoute(). Each language maps to its own coder µ family (c, cpp, python, ts, js, rust, go).

Geometry / physics routing micronaut. Handles physical-model gram sequences (force, field, curvature, geodesic, manifold). Routes to kuhul-maya-agent domain for π-field propagation and geodesic gram vector scoring.

Intent gap sink. When no µ wins the gram field (all WCR scores below threshold), the request lands here. Signals that the gram tensor B has a knowledge gap — triggers the FACTORY-µ unfold-miss pipeline: Unfold(B,Q) → F_Q → Advisor repair.

Infrastructure memory backing. Provides the raw gram store read/write primitives that MEM-µ and MEMORY-µ build on. Analogous to the Librarian for storage: MEM-µ is the user-facing interface, memory-agent is the infrastructure layer.
Infrastructure reasoning. Backs REASON-µ at the implementation layer. The split mirrors Librarian/WEB-RESEARCH-µ — reasoner is the substrate, REASON-µ is the user-facing semantic contract.
